{"consolidated_memory":"SCHEDULER MISSED RUN ISSUES IN worker/scheduler/cron.py (BACKGROUND JOBS)

Three separate occasions of the missed run problem, each with distinct triggers and root causes:

OCCASION 1 - [2026-03-11]
- Trigger: First request after a cold start
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Signal: Slot with no execution record
- Reproduction: Advance fake clock across the schedule
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #5292 on branch fix/missed-run-2
- Measured outcome: Flaky test went from 67 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2 - [2026-06-25]
- Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation
- Signal: Slot with no execution record
- Reproduction: Advance fake clock across the schedule
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #7164 on branch fix/missed-run-3
- Measured outcome: 57 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

OCCASION 3 - [2026-08-28]
- Trigger: Users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Signal: Slot with no execution record
- Reproduction: Advance fake clock across the schedule
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #8124 on branch fix/missed-run-4
- Test file: tests/worker/test_cron.py
- Stack: Python
- Measured outcome: Error rate dropped from 6.0% to under 2 per ten thousand (0.02%)

All three issues were in the same corner of worker/scheduler/cron.py, with context carrying over between fixes."}
